answer_1.quote: we align Mistral with VLM preferences and generate descriptions that contain features that are important for the VLM.

answer_2.quote: we consider a set of descriptions helpful if they achieve better image classification accuracy on the corresponding task than the ensemble of 80 generic descriptions.

answer_3.quote: We use ChatGPT to automatically inspect the large number of descriptions.

answer_4.quote: We also do a manual evaluation of the quality of ChatGPT inspections and get reasonable results.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged whether each description is informative and whether it contains visual attributes.
